contexts.text: How terrible is this place () = holiness of state... For the word terrible, in the Original, is derived from the same word as fear (which) = what is holy.
But in Hell (truth Divine) is terrible.
The terrible day = the advent of the Lord to Judgment.
Because this state is profane and powerful, it is called terrible, etc. (). AE 650:68.
Hence those in falsities are called terrible, etc.
